body:
## Fix

F1. Validate a cached Git repository's origin before trusting its contents. A valid repository at the expected cache path must match the configured source; offline mismatch rejects instead of attributing another repository's commit to the configured source.
F2. Use a static mismatch diagnostic. Parent review caught raw cached-origin interpolation in the first implementation; revised code does not expose URL credentials through diagnostics or error causes.
F3. Add local temporary-Git regressions for wrong-origin rejection and credential-safe diagnostics. No live acquisition.

## Validation

V1. Core bug reproduced before origin check. Security regression separately reproduced disclosure before correction; both now pass.
V2. Parent reran acquisition-related legacy suite: 15 passed; capped-response-body suite: 4 passed.
V3. Parent reviewed original/updated diff, diagnostic error chain, offline rejection, and test assertions. No remaining blocking finding.
V4. Typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed.

## Limits

L1. Exact URL equality rejects equivalent manually rewritten origins. This is a consistency check, not cryptographic proof of repository provenance.
L2. Online mismatch uses existing invalid-cache replacement flow; no live replacement/acquisition was run. Full repository/browser suites not run locally. CI remains separate.
title: fix(assets): reject mismatched source caches safely
